scope: Observed Loft Join/Cut/Intersect/NewBody operations, explicit single input body selections and component-context sketch profile membership; no loft regeneration.

integration.callsite: Replace the Loft decode_tools branch call with this helper; it calls decode_loft_modes independently and introduces no decode_loft fallback cycle.
integration.shared_change: decode_loft_modes has keyword-only allowed_operation_codes=(4,) and profile_resolver=resolve_sketch_profiles defaults. It now exposes result_anchor_list_end_relative_offset. Existing default operation acceptance remains NewBody only.
integration.component_helper: resolve_component_sketch_profiles(data, records, selection_id, owner_id, features) accepts only observed 125-byte populated-context, single-descriptor/single-profile-set variant; generic native_proxy_references is unchanged.

layout.result_anchors: NewBody has one counted typed D263 anchor; captured Join/Cut/Intersect have zero new-body anchors. Zero does not mean no resulting API body.
layout.input_body_list: After result-anchor list: observed uint32 zero, uint32 proxy count, 11-byte references. Counts are 0 for NewBody and 1 for observed Join/Cut/Intersect. Next uint32=36 guards UUID text boundary.
layout.component_profiles: 125-byte 2CA proxy: one4BD descriptor, two populated2E3 context slots, one2DF7 secondary token, owned71-byte trailer. Descriptor has explicit namespace and decimal sketch ID, oneC46D context and reciprocal6CCF support to source sketch feature. Each2E3 frame owns typed frame-link/route-wrapper/96CB route. Captured slot modes1,0 share terminal namespace/entity UUID; mode1 namespace/context UUID also matches descriptor context. Profile0D57 points back to descriptor and curve tags resolve to explicit named source sketches.
layout.stored_context_index: C46D profile context uint32 at2 stores0 and1 for the two captured sections; preserved without assigning a general index meaning.

observations: Requested API NewComponent=4 returns actual API NewBody=3 and native operation4, result API body in Component1; a separate native NewComponent operation code is not established.

Join/Cut/Intersect owned proxies independently select native body297, descriptor398, anchor303, source Extrude owner265. Typed custom-name property says StudyBlock. Cut/Intersect participant getters agree; Join participant getter was not queried and is not counted as a participant comparison.
Native result/input identities are design record IDs, not ASM indices. Historical input297 is not assumed to be a live result body merely because its stored custom name matches API StudyBlock.
Both component section routes share the same terminal UUID despite source sketch IDs310 and363. Terminal UUID is therefore kept as opaque context evidence and is not labeled as a sketch UUID.
limitations: Only one explicit target body for observed Join/Cut/Intersect; multi-body participants and operation/rail/closed combinations are unverified.
Component context slot direction, terminal UUID identity, occurrence transforms and context geometry transformations unresolved.
Component profile support is single descriptor and single profile set with observed mode1/mode0 context slots; other context variants rejected.
Result visibility, body lifecycle, topological matching, exact loft surfaces, kernel regeneration and native file writing remain unresolved.
API default UI names Body1/Body2/Component1 and opaque entity tokens are retained as observations; they are not manufactured from empty native names or matched by token string.
